title: Concept: Unbounded copy into a fixed-size buffer in c — review required
description: In c, strcpy writes an unbounded string into a fixed buffer. The C library cannot detect the overflow, and compilers only add checks when hardening flags are enabled, so the failure appears as memory corruption rather than a clean error. Input-driven copies through this function are a classic route to code execution.
applicability: c native code that handles external strings.
risk: Memory corruption and possible code execution; HIGH severity.
